comment: Overall impression: The draft is timely, ambitious and technically strong, providing a much-needed bridge between national health goals and the shared, governed, standards-based infrastructure needed to achieve them. With progress towards UN SDG 3 remaining uneven, the world needs a globally aligned yet locally adaptable health reference architecture, one capable of enabling truly paperless, person-centred health records and secure semantic interoperability not only between systems, but ultimately across countries.
